item.title: Seattle Cascades adding a dedicated trombone line for 2027
item.description:
The Seattle Cascades are bringing a dedicated trombone line to the field for their 2027 production, according to newly installed program coordinator and brass arranger Todd Zimbelman. The design team is already well into work on the corps' yet-to-be-revealed 2027 show, and the trombone line is one of its defining choices.

A dedicated trombone section is a distinctive instrumentation call — most corps fold trombones into the broader brass line — so it hints at a show built around the instrument's sound and visual identity. More details will presumably follow as the Cascades reveal the full 2027 production.

item.title: Corps news roundup: Tokyo auditions, a full trombone line, and Halloween parades
item.description:
DCI's latest corps news roundup covers announcements from across the activity: the Blue Stars will host auditions in Tokyo, expanding their international reach, while the Seattle Cascades are set to field a full marching trombone section — a distinctive instrumentation choice that will stand out on the field.

Elsewhere in the roundup, the Caballeros Alumni are ringing in spooky season with a Halloween parade appearance, and DCI All-Age news rounds out the edition. It's an offseason snapshot of corps already building toward next summer, from global audition tours to creative programming decisions taking shape months before the first show.
